title: Data Wrangling with SageMaker Data Wrangler [Hands-On] - Part 1

cues.en: Hello my friends and welcome to this new hands-on tutorial on data wrangling, with this time, SageMaker.
cues.zh: 朋友們好，歡迎來到新的資料整理實作，這次使用 SageMaker。

cues.en: All right, we're gonna do the same as what we had previously with AWS Glue DataBrew, same dataset, but this time with SageMaker.
cues.zh: 和先前 AWS Glue DataBrew 做相同事情、相同資料集，但這次使用 SageMaker。

cues.en: And we're gonna do this in two parts.
cues.zh: 分兩個部分。

cues.en: In the first part we'll do the setup of SageMaker and you have to know, I have to give you a pricing disclaimer that Amazon SageMaker incurs some charges.
cues.zh: 第一部分設定 SageMaker，先提醒價格：Amazon SageMaker 會產生費用。

cues.en: So if you don't want to take any risk with your money, I would recommend only watching this tutorial.
cues.zh: 如果不想有金錢風險，建議只觀看教學。

cues.en: However, if you wanna do the tutorial with me, well, just make sure to do the cleanup tutorial with me at the end of this section and stop the charges, okay?
cues.zh: 如果想跟著操作，務必在本節最後跟著清理教學，停止計費，好嗎？

cues.en: So here we go.
cues.zh: 開始吧。

cues.en: Let's go into the search bar and let's enter SageMaker.
cues.zh: 到搜尋列輸入 SageMaker。

cues.en: And here, careful, don't click the Amazon SageMaker service here.
cues.zh: 注意，不要點這裡的 Amazon SageMaker 服務。

cues.en: The one we're gonna use is this one, Amazon SageMaker AI, all right?
cues.zh: 要使用的是 Amazon SageMaker AI。

cues.en: To build, train, and deploy machine learning models, but here we'll just do data preprocessing.
cues.zh: 用來建立、訓練、部署模型，但這裡只做資料前處理。

cues.en: All right, so I can't wait to introduce you to Canvas, which will be the SageMaker app that we'll use to do the data wrangling.
cues.zh: 迫不及待介紹 Canvas，這是用來整理資料的 SageMaker 應用程式。

cues.en: And so welcome to Amazon's SageMaker AI, and our first step will be to click this button, Set up for single user.
cues.zh: 歡迎來到 Amazon SageMaker AI，第一步按 Set up for single user。

cues.en: This will create a SageMaker domain, after which we'll create an app, which will be exactly the Canvas app, all right?
cues.zh: 會建立 SageMaker 網域，接著建立應用程式，也就是 Canvas。

cues.en: And at the same time, while your domain is created, while a user profile will also be created right here.
cues.zh: 建立網域的同時，也會在這裡建立使用者設定檔。

cues.en: You probably won't see it yet, because the domain is still being created, but it will be created in a few dozens of seconds.
cues.zh: 目前可能還沒看到，因為網域建立中，數十秒後會出現。

cues.en: Let's see, let's see. Still not, okay?
cues.zh: 看看，還沒，好。

cues.en: So we're gonna refresh from time to time to see if we see it appear, and we'll also get a notification.
cues.zh: 不時重新整理，看看是否出現，也會收到通知。

cues.en: By the way, this came back.
cues.zh: 順帶一提，這個畫面回來了。

cues.en: As you can see, it is still preparing the SageMaker domain.
cues.zh: 可以看到，仍在準備 SageMaker 網域。

cues.en: Please do not close this browser tab.
cues.zh: 請不要關閉瀏覽器分頁。

cues.en: And yes, it takes usually, you know, one to two minutes maybe, and you will get not only your SageMaker domain, but also your user profile.
cues.zh: 通常需要一到兩分鐘，就會同時得到 SageMaker 網域與使用者設定檔。

cues.en: So I'll see you once everything is ready.
cues.zh: 準備好再見。

cues.en: And here we go, the SageMaker domain is ready, and so as you can see, a user profile appeared here, which will be named by default like that.
cues.zh: 好了，網域已完成，可以看到使用者設定檔出現在這裡，預設名稱像這樣。

cues.en: And from this user profile you can indeed, launch some applications, and the one we're gonna launch is exactly this one, Canvas, because it contains a data wrangling feature
cues.zh: 從設定檔可以啟動應用程式，要啟動的是 Canvas，因為有資料整理功能，

cues.en: which will allow you to do data preprocessing on your data just exactly how we did with AWS Glue DataBrew.
cues.zh: 能像先前 AWS Glue DataBrew 一樣，對資料做前處理。

cues.en: You will see it's super practical.
cues.zh: 你會看到非常實用。

cues.en: I'm curious to know which of the two will be your favorite.
cues.zh: 很好奇這兩者，你最喜歡哪個。

cues.en: I personally like AWS Glue DataBrew, but I also use Canvas.
cues.zh: 我個人喜歡 AWS Glue DataBrew，但也使用 Canvas。

cues.en: Both are really good.
cues.zh: 兩者都很好。

cues.en: All right, so let's wait for the application to be created, and I'll see you once we are ready within Canvas.
cues.zh: 等待應用程式建立，進入 Canvas 準備好後再見。

cues.en: And it seems to be ready already.
cues.zh: 看起來已經準備好了。

cues.en: I can see it loading from here, so I think it's just a matter of seconds now, there we go, before we get into Canvas.
cues.zh: 這裡正在載入，應該再幾秒就能進入 Canvas。

cues.en: So here we go, welcome to Canvas.
cues.zh: 好了，歡迎來到 Canvas。

cues.en: It's an amazing platform for machine learning, but even data preprocessing, as you're about to see.
cues.zh: 它是很棒的機器學習平台，也能做資料前處理，接著就會看到。

cues.en: So that's it for this first tutorial on this setup, and I'll see you for the second part in the next hands-on tutorial.
cues.zh: 第一堂設定教學結束，下一堂實作進入第二部分。
